description: Feather is modern, intuitive, convention based, mobile-first UI for Telerik Sitefinity™. This NuGet package does not have dependencies on any Telerik Sitefinity™ related NuGet packages and thus it is expected that the core Telerik Sitefinity™ packages are already installed in your project. Note that this NuGet package can be installed only on Telerik Sitefinity™ web application projects.
title: Telerik.Sitefinity.Feather
